title: Codex CLI adapter
description: Managed block in ~/.codex/AGENTS.md (core rules inline, explicit routing to ~/.agents), five custom agents, optional 'lean' profile file. Never touches config.toml.
postInstall: Codex: start a new session to load ~/.codex/AGENTS.md. Custom agents are in ~/.codex/agents/ and inherit your model; add model = "<id>" per file to route strong vs small models. Codex delegates when you ask or when AGENTS.md/skill instructions request it; naming the role helps (for example: 'use claim_verifier on these claims').Optional profile: codex --profile lean (medium effort, concise summaries, low verbosity, memories off). Your config.toml was not changed.
